contentEn.description:
Great Studio on the Beachfront in Marbella Center 
 free wifi

 Lovely studio apartment in the 9th floor of the frontline Neptuno Building, in the centre of Marbella. It has wonderful sea views and direct access to the Paseo Marítimo (maritime promenade) from the communal gardens and pools.

 Accommodation comprises: lift access; large lounge / bedroom with folding double bed, separate sofa, flat-screen TV, built-in wardrobe, and access to the furnished south-facing terrace overlooking the Mediterranean Sea; fully-equipped open-plan kitchen with hob, fridge, microwave, coffee maker, and everything you need for your home comforts; separate full bathroom with shower. The apartment is equipped with A/C and heating, and Wi-Fi internet connection.

 The apartment has its own Wi-Fi, ideal for working remotely.

 Private A/C.

 The pool is open from the 15th of June to the 15th of September, both inclusive. The pool hours are from 12 pm until 8 pm. 

 Check-in (from 4pm): the keys will be in a key box in our office; we will provide you with the information prior to your arrival. It is important that you tell us your estimated arrival time at least 48 hours before.

 Bed linen and a set of towels (including beach/pool towel) per guest are included in the rental price.

 LATEST AVAILABILITY FOR STUDIO IN MARBELLA
